chunks: And Ibrāhīm ibn Hāshim narrated from Ṣāliḥ ibn al-Sindī, from al-Ḥusayn ibn Khālid, from al-Riḍā عليه السلام:
He was asked about a man who had a slave woman, and the slave woman said to him, “Whatever I have paid of my emancipation contract, I am free in proportion to that.” So he said to her, “Yes.”

Then she paid part of her emancipation contract, and her master had intercourse with her after that. He عليه السلام said: “If he forced her into that, he is to be struck with the hadd punishment in proportion to what she has paid of her emancipation contract, and the hadd punishment is averted from him in proportion to what remained for him of her emancipation contract. And if she complied with him, she was his partner in the hadd punishment and is to be struck the like of what he is struck.”

key_terms.حُرَّةٌ: free, in proportion to the fulfilled contract
key_terms.دُرِئَ عَنْهُ: it was averted or waived from him
key_terms.شَرِيكَتَهُ فِي الْحَدِّ: his partner in the prescribed punishment
key_terms.مُكَاتَبَتِي: my emancipation contract by which a slave purchases freedom in installments

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling if a master has intercourse with a slave woman who has partially paid her emancipation contract?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning a mukatabah slave woman who has paid part of her emancipation contract and whose master then has intercourse with her. The ruling states that legal punishment is apportioned according to the portion of freedom she had acquired, and if she consented, she shares in the hadd punishment.
